oneLineSummary: No mainstream CAS (GAP/Sage/Mathematica/Magma/FORM) auto-computes Aut(S) at algebra level; Wilmot's geoalg Python (github.com/GPWilmot/geoalg) + discretegames/hypercomplex are closest; direct 256-entry sigma-by-sigma M-preservation testing is UNPUBLISHED — potential SYMPOSIUM contribution.
rootCause: Sage OctonionAlgebra caps at dim 8 (derivations_basis only). GAP LOOPS handles Cayley-Dickson LOOP automorphism (32-element multiplicative closure) but NOT R-algebra automorphism. Literature dispute G2-only vs G2xS3 means OSS hasn't crystallized.
recommendation: Layered verification stack: (1) hypercomplex Python for 16x16 mult table, (2) sigma-by-sigma 256-entry M-preservation with stabilizer-chain pruning (fix 1, e1, e2, e4 -> reduce to ~10^6 rational G2 points + at most 6 S3 cosets, tractable <1h), (3) cross-validate vs GPWilmot/geoalg and GAP LOOPS bound, (4) Lean 4 Mathlib formalization (Mathlib has CayleyDickson; no sedenion-automorphism theorem yet -- SYMPOSIUM contribution).
caveats: Full S_16 enumeration = 2.1e13 perms x 256 entries = ~5e15 ops infeasible. MUST use stabilizer pruning. Cariow 2013 122-mult/283-add sedenion mult kernel for production speed.
